claim.claim-text: 1. An image processing method in a computer that diagnoses lesions from a picked-up image, the image processing method comprising:
2. The image processing method according to claim 1, further comprising:
inputting a high-resolution rectangular image as the reference image; and preparing, beforehand, a low-resolution square image from the high-resolution rectangular image.
3. The image processing method according to claim 2, wherein the geometric transformation on the reference image comprises:

preparing, beforehand, a plurality of the low-resolution square images having multiple patterns of rotation angle and multiplication factor changed from the high-resolution rectangular image that is the picked-up image; and performing geometric increase on at least one of the low-resolution square image and inputting images resulting from the geometric increase into a neural network for machine learning, and creating the ensemble identifier (14a), wherein the geometric increase includes a 90-degree rotation and an inversion.
4. The image processing method according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein:

the ensemble identifier (14a) comprises at least two unit identifiers (142, 143); and the reference image is subjected to geometric transformation based on different pattern for each of the unit identifiers (142, 143).
5. An image processing method in a computer that diagnoses lesions from a picked-up image, the image processing method comprising:
6. The image processing method according to claim 5, further comprising:
inputting a high-resolution rectangular image; and preparing, beforehand, as the query image, a low-resolution square image from the high-resolution rectangular image.

7. The image processing method according to claim 5 or 6, wherein: the ensemble identifier (14a) comprises a plurality of unit identifiers (142, 143); and the query image is subjected to geometric transformation based on different pattern for each of the unit identifiers (142, 143).
8. An image processing device for diagnosing lesions from a picked-up image, wherein:
9. A diagnosis assisting device (1) for diagnosing lesions from a picked-up image, wherein:
10. A program for causing a computer to perform the method according to any one of claim 1 to 7.
